label: PF Backlog 620
title: Capture per-task model usage (input/output/cache tokens + cost) and wall-time; record on the backlog item (DoD)

brief.what_adds: An API endpoint + model-usage wiring to record execution.usage + time on items, rolled up to the epic and surfaced at delivery
brief.problem: No per-task token/cost/time on items; agent cannot self-report tokens/cost (runtime-only)

objective: Capture per-task model usage (input/output/cache tokens + cost) and wall-time; record on the backlog item (DoD)
acceptance_criteria: Objective achieved: Capture per-task model usage (input/output/cache tokens + cost) and wall-time; record on the backlog item (DoD)
in_scope: Capture per-task model usage (input/output/cache tokens + cost) and wall-time; record on the backlog item (DoD)
approach: RESEARCHED (net): OpenCode persists REAL usage in SQLite ~/.local/share/opencode/opencode.db (verified present, 51GB). The 'session' table rows carry: cost, tokens_input, tokens_output, tokens_reasoning, tokens_cache_read, tokens_cache_write, model, directory, time_created/time_updated -> gives input/output/cache-hit(read)/cache-miss(write) tokens + cost + wall-time directly (API-reported, not estimated). Also a built-in 'opencode stats' CLI aggregates by day/model/agent/project. Implementation: scripts/dev/usage_capture.py reads opencode.db (read-only) for the task's session/time window -> maps to execution.usage {input_tokens, output_tokens, cache_read, cache_write, cost_usd, reasoning_tokens} + duration_seconds -> writes via new POST /backlog/items/{id}/execution -> epic rollup + delivery. Path is harness-specific; keep a provider-usage fallback (core model-call 'usage') for framework-agnostic mode.
verification: Objective achieved: Capture per-task model usage (input/output/cache tokens + cost) and wall-time; record on the backlog item (DoD)

analysis.implementation_strategy: Extend existing components/APIs: core/agent_model_override.py, core/backlog.py, core/backlog_link.py, core/business_models_kb.py
